info.title: Beauty on Wheels - Booking Service API
info.description: Create and manage customer bookings and booking lifecycle transitions.

get.description: Lists bookings owned by the authenticated customer.

post.description: Creates a PENDING_PAYMENT booking from a selected civil date/time. Customer identity and authoritative price are server-assigned; slotId, holdId, quoteId, and offeringVersion are not accepted. Idempotency-Key is required.

requestBody.description: Create booking request. Does not accept quoteId or totalAmount.
